sentences.text: The case of the petitioners is that they are the owners of the property, which is the subject matter of the writ petition.
It is alleged that the respondent - BBMP is trying to utilize the property by encroaching upon the same, without acquiring it and without following the due process of law.

Hence, the writ petition is filed with the following prayers:
"i. Issue a Writ of Mandamus restraining the Respondents, their officers, agents, or contractors from dispossessing the Petitioners, demolishing any structures, removing trees and /or in any manner interfering with the Petitioners' peaceful possession and enjoyment of properties bearing PID Nos.67-3- 141/1 and 67-3-141/2-1 situated at Jakkasandra Village, Begur Hobli, Bengaluru South Taluk, except in accordance with Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013; and ii. Pass such other orders as this Hon'ble Court may deemed fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of this case, in the interest of justice and equity."
NC: 2025:KHC:39000 HC-KAR 2.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the respondent-BBMP, upon instructions, submits that the title deeds of the property will be verified.
If it is found that the property is a government land, the same will be utilized without giving any compensation to the petitioners.

If it is found to be the land belonging to the petitioners, then in that event the same will be utilized only after following the due process of law and acquiring it in the manner known to law and not otherwise.
His submission is placed on record.

3. Respondents are directed to utilize the property, which is the subject matter of the writ petition,
only after following the due process of law and not otherwise.
4.
The Writ Petition is hereby disposed of.

Sd/-
